'Sword Art Online' Original Movie Announces Main Staff, 2028 Premiere
The official website for the Sword Art Online anime series revealed on Tuesday the main staff, official title, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser trailer for the previously announced original anime movie. The movie, titled Integral Domaine, is scheduled to open in theaters in 2028. Voice actors Yoshitsugu Matsuoka and Haruka Tomatsu return as Kazuto Kirigaya and Asuna Yuuki, respectively.
